name: Gu-vandi
description: The Gu-vandi were a sentient species. They were governed by the Gu-vandi Collective, and their area of space included the world Praven Prime, home to the L'Xing species. At some point by 3951 BBY, an HK-50 series assassin droid posing as a translator intentionally mistranslated a L'Xing language phrase, causing a civil war between the Gu-vandi Collective and the L'Xing. As a result of the conflict, the Galactic Republic withdrew its presence from Gu-vandi space.
